_provenance.source: Health Canada — Nutrition labelling: Table of daily values (canada.ca), published 2022-10-20
_provenance.in_force_note: This is the in-force table; the previous 2016-12-14 version sunset 2025-12-31.
_provenance.column_note: Adult / general-population column: Part 1 Column 3 for macronutrients + sodium; Part 2 Column 4 ('any other case') for vitamins and minerals. Vitamin forms follow Food and Drug Regulations D.01.003.
_provenance.id_note: Keys are CNF NutrientIDs; each id fixes the unit so the amount and the DV are always in the same unit. Vitamin A = Retinol Activity Equivalents (320); Vitamin D = D2 + D3 in micrograms (328); Vitamin E = alpha-tocopherol (323); Niacin = niacin equivalents (409); Folate = Dietary Folate Equivalents (435).
_provenance.excluded_note: Cholesterol (601) has a 300 mg DV but Canadian Nutrition Facts tables show no %DV, so it is omitted. Protein and total carbohydrate carry no Canadian %DV. Iodide, chromium, molybdenum, chloride are absent from CNF.
_provenance.percent_dv_formula: percent_dv = amount / dv * 100, computed on the per-100 g amount unless scaled upstream. Saturated fat (606) sums with trans fat (605) per sum_with_nutrient_id.
